Фотоэлемент – устройство, преобразующее: A photoelement is a device that converts electromagnetic radiation energy into electrical energy. The simplest photoelement is a semiconductor device with a p-n junction. When optical radiation is absorbed, due to the internal photoelectric effect, the number of free charge carriers increases, which are separated by the junction field. As a result, a potential difference – photo-EMF – is created on both sides of the junction.
